description: The services a project is connected to, each with its id, its account, its keys by name (never their values) and, when the service has stopped working, `attention`: what happened, what it means and how to fix it, in the words CodeGene's own notice uses. Also `suggestions`: services CodeGene noticed the project's original site used and that are not connected yet, each saying what the person can do (for an owner or admin, the connect_service call that finishes it). Owners and admins also see the settings that are not secret.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: list_connections
title: A project's connections
